svg.title: Светлый силуэт карты для афиши
svg.metadata: Natural Earth; © OpenStreetMap contributors, Wambacher (via geoBoundaries). Natural Earth: public domain; regional boundary data: ODbL 1.0. https://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/1-0/ . Sources: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_50m_admin_0_countries.geojson ; https://github.com/wmgeolab/geoBoundaries/raw/9469f09/releaseData/gbOpen/UKR/ADM1/geoBoundaries-UKR-ADM1_simplified.geojson . Derived geometry: source/russia-silhouette-geodata.geojson (ODbL 1.0). Changes: United country and six requested region geometries; Albers equal-area projection; antimeridian unwrapped; simplified 2.5 km at country scale; small dataset seams closed at 1.8 km; uniform scale only, no stroke, light grey fill (#e8e8e5), enlarged to 1880 px on the 1920 px canvas. . Boundary convention: Requested depiction follows Russian territorial claims, including Crimea, Sevastopol and the full Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson regions; it is not a map of international recognition or current military control.
